verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out for Working Copy. The only privacy controls shown are an opt-in for AI features that send staged diffs to OpenAI. That is a related but different control and earns no credit toward a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
